create_wigner_data_module: create a WignerDataModule with precomputed Wigner D coefficients and U blocks for a given lmax and lmin
precompute_wigner_coefficients: precompute Wigner D matrix coefficients for angular momentum levels lmin through lmax using symmetry to halve computation
wigner_d_matrix_real: compute Wigner D matrices from Ra and Rb real and imaginary parts using precomputed coefficients and real-pair arithmetic
quaternion_to_ra_rb_real: decompose a quaternion tensor in w,x,y,z convention into the real and imaginary parts of Ra and Rb
wigner_d_pair_to_real: transform complex Wigner D matrices given as real and imaginary parts into real spherical harmonic basis using U blocks
